name: com.herbertandphyllis/mcp
title: Herbert & Phyllis Kosher Gifts
description: Kosher gift shop: search, compare, delivery dates, checkout links, tree certificates, free Mishnayos

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search the kosher gift catalogue. Budget, stock and shipping filters are applied as hard constraints before ranking, so nothing above max_price is ever returned. Returns an empty result with an explanation rather than a nearest-miss when nothing matches.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "dried mango" or "large basket".

max_price.description: Hard ceiling in USD. Nothing above it is returned.

occasion.description: An occasion key from list_occasions, e.g. "shiva".

category.description: A category name from a product, e.g. "Fruit & Nut Gifts".

must_ship_nationwide.description: True to exclude the fresh platters, which are hand-delivered in one metro area only.

include_out_of_stock.description: True to include sold-out products. Default false.

limit.description: How many to return, up to 25.

tools.name: get_gift
tools.description: Full detail for one product by id or slug, plus any other listing of the same physical item (the catalogue carries occasion-specific listings of the same basket) so it is offered once, not twice.

product_key.description: A product id or slug from search_gifts.

tools.name: list_occasions
tools.description: The occasion keys search_gifts accepts, with how many gifts each has. Derived from the products themselves, so it never offers a filter that would return nothing.

tools.name: compare_gifts
tools.description: Side-by-side detail for 2 to 5 products, for choosing between them.

tools.name: recommend_gifts
tools.description: A short ranked shortlist for an occasion and budget. Each entry carries the reason, built only from facts on the product. The shop holds no ratings or reviews, so none are returned.

occasion.description: An occasion key from list_occasions, e.g. "shiva".

budget.description: Most the customer wants to spend, in USD.

must_ship_nationwide.description: True to exclude the fresh platters, which are hand-delivered in the New York City area only.

tools.name: check_delivery
tools.description: Whether a product can reach a destination and the dates it can arrive: free Standard, and any paid faster speed that beats it. Give the ZIP for the exact dates. Orders placed by 10am ET on a business day ship the same day from California, and the trays from New York ship the same day if ordered by 1pm ET. Standard shipping is free in the United States. Paid 2-Day and Overnight are offered for a ZIP when they arrive sooner than free Standard. Ordered now, with no ZIP yet: Overnight can arrive as soon as Thu, Nov 26 (2026-11-26), free Standard by Wed, Dec 2 (2026-12-02). For the real date to an address, call check_delivery with the recipient's ZIP.

product_key.description: A product id or slug from search_gifts.

zip.description: Recipient 5-digit ZIP code, for the exact dates the cart would show.

requested_date.description: The date it must arrive by, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_shop_policies
tools.description: Kosher certification wording, cutoffs and delivery dates, shipping cost, sales tax, policy links, and what this server can and cannot do about payment. Read this before telling a customer anything about certification or delivery. Orders placed by 10am ET on a business day ship the same day from California, and the trays from New York ship the same day if ordered by 1pm ET.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Server-side totals for a cart: merchandise, shipping, sales tax and the grand total. Prices come from the database, never from the caller. Indicative only. Checkout recomputes every figure at payment and that is what is charged. Discount codes are not evaluated here.

product_key.description: A product id or slug from search_gifts.

destination_state.description: Two-letter US state code; needed for an exact tax figure.

recipient_zip.description: Recipient 5-digit ZIP code. Needed to price a paid delivery speed.

delivery_speed.description: standard (free, default), 2day or overnight (paid, only where faster than standard).

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Build the order into a cart on herbertandphyllis.com, prefilled with the gift, recipient, delivery date and card message. No key needed. THIS DOES NOT CHARGE ANYTHING. It returns a link the buyer opens, reviews and pays from with the normal Checkout button; nothing is charged until they do, and this server never sees card details. Prices, shipping, tax and discount codes are worked out by the shop. Confirm the items, the recipient address, the delivery speed and the total with the customer BEFORE calling this. Without a key: up to 10 lines and 20 items, and 10 carts an hour per connection. Standard shipping is free in the United States. Paid 2-Day and Overnight are offered for a ZIP when they arrive sooner than free Standard.

product_key.description: A product id or slug from search_gifts.

recipient_name.description: Who receives the gift, e.g. "The Cohen Family".

recipient_address.description: Street address, with apartment if any.

buyer_email.description: The buyer's email. The receipt and any order lookup use it.

coupon_code.description: Validated server-side at checkout; an invalid code is ignored.

requested_arrival_date.description: Requested arrival, YYYY-MM-DD. Refused if sooner than the earliest date for the chosen speed and ZIP.

delivery_speed.description: standard (free, default), 2day or overnight (paid, only where faster than standard; check_delivery lists them).

tools.name: quote_trees
tools.description: Price for N trees planted in Israel with one dedication certificate, and the optional printed, mailed copy (5). Prices come from the live shop. Trees are not taxed. No key needed.

printed_copy.description: True to add a printed certificate mailed by post (+$5).

tools.name: create_tree_checkout_link
tools.description: Build a cart on herbertandphyllis.com for N trees planted in Israel with a personalised Certificate of Dedication. No key needed. THIS DOES NOT CHARGE ANYTHING: the buyer opens the cart, reviews it and checks out. After payment the certificate is emailed within minutes to the buyer and, if given, the family; a printed copy is mailed if printed_copy is set (+$5). Confirm the honoree name, spelling, dedication and total with the customer BEFORE calling this: the certificate is issued exactly as sent. Without a key: up to 20 trees, and 10 carts an hour per connection.

tree_count.description: How many trees, 1 to 50, all on one certificate.

dedication.description: The line above the name on the certificate.

honoree_name.description: The name printed on the certificate.

hebrew_name.description: Optional, in Hebrew letters only, e.g. "משה בן אברהם".

language.description: Certificate wording: "en" English (default), "he" Hebrew, or "both" (Hebrew above English).

passing_date.description: Optional date of passing, for a memorial.

message.description: Short message printed on the certificate.

from.description: Who the trees are from, as printed on the certificate.

family_email.description: Also email the certificate to the family.

send_on.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD, today to 12 months ahead: email the family on that date (e.g. the yahrzeit) at 8am New York time instead of right away. The buyer still gets the certificate right after paying. Leave out to send right away.

printed_copy.description: Mail a printed copy to this US address (+$5).

name.description: Who the printed copy is addressed to.

buyer_email.description: The buyer's email. The certificate and receipt go here.

coupon_code.description: Validated server-side at checkout; an invalid code is ignored.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status and tracking for ONE order. Both the order number and the email the order was placed with are required, and both must match, a token alone cannot look up an order. Returns the same answer for "no such order" and "not your order", so order numbers cannot be probed. Never returns the street address, phone number or card message.

order_number.description: The number on the confirmation email, e.g. 10432.

buyer_email.description: The email the order was placed with.

tools.name: start_mishnayos_page
tools.description: Start a free Mishnayos learning page in memory of someone (for shloshim, a yahrzeit or another date). Family and friends open the public link and each take perakim. FREE, no account, no payment. Needs the organizer's OWN email: the private link for managing the page is emailed there and is never returned here, so never use another person's address. Confirm the names and spelling with the person BEFORE calling this. Returns the public page link to share.

organizer_name.description: The name of the person setting up the page (the one asking you).

organizer_email.description: The organizer's own email. The private manage link is emailed here only.

name.description: The name of the person being remembered, in English, e.g. "Moshe Cohen".

hebrew_name.description: Optional. Their Hebrew name exactly as the family gave it, in Hebrew or English letters, e.g. "משה" or "Moshe". Never guess or transliterate it; leave it out if the family did not give one. Needed only for letters_of_name, which needs Hebrew letters.

ben_bas.description: "ben" (son of) or "bas" (daughter of). Needed only with father_hebrew_name.

father_hebrew_name.description: The father's Hebrew name as the family gave it, in Hebrew or English letters. Optional.

passed_after_sunset.description: True if the passing was after sunset (the Hebrew date is the next day).

finish_by.description: Date to finish by, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: shloshim if date_of_passing is given and it is still ahead, else 30 days from today.

what_to_learn.description: all_of_shas: all of Mishnayos, 523 perakim. letters_of_name: one perek per letter of the Hebrew name, then נשמה. Default all_of_shas.
